label: Filesystem
summary: Read & write files inside a chosen directory. Useful for letting agents share artifacts across an incident.

label: Fetch (HTTP)
summary: Lets agents fetch URLs over HTTP/HTTPS. Sandboxed to GET only.

label: Memory (knowledge graph)
summary: Persistent knowledge graph that survives across incidents. Agents can record IOCs, suspect users, etc.

label: GitHub
summary: Search code, create issues, post incident write-ups to a private repo.

label: SQLite
summary: Query a local SQLite database. Handy for hunting across previously parsed log evidence.

label: Brave Search
summary: Web search via Brave's API. Good for OSINT / TI lookups.
